descriptionChirho: The Greek noun υἱός denoting a male offspring, descendant, or one belonging to a category (e.g., 'sons of light,' 'sons of Abraham'). All 382 NT occurrences—whether nominative, accusative, genitive, dative, singular or plural—share this core meaning. Multilingual evidence is uniform: Spanish 'hijo/hijos,' Arabic 'ابن/بنين,' Hindi 'पुत्र,' Korean '아들,' Swahili 'mwana/wana.' The split between S78013 (379x, all cases singular and plural) and S78016 (3x, dative/nominative plural with prepositional collocations like 'with-sons' or 'to-sons') reflects only grammatical case and number variation, not a distinct sense. Both clusters translate identically across all target languages.
